name: Scrobbling
description: Sends what you listen to to ListenBrainz and Last.fm. A track counts after half of it (or 4 minutes) has really been heard. Plays made offline are kept and sent later.

settings.label: Last.fm API key
settings.hint: Your own API account (last.fm/api/account/create) until bootleg has one. Then sign in on the Scrobbling page.

settings.label: Show what's playing now
settings.hint: Tell the services about a track as it starts, not only once it counts.

settings.label: Scrobble stem sets
settings.hint: Stem sets are often your own work in progress, so they are left out unless you choose otherwise.
